observed_card_references.meaning: Exact duplicate references among saved histories, NOT instrumented cache-hit counts or saved GPU calls.

exact_from_saved_evidence: accepted inspect_history calls and requested video IDs
correction requests whose final user message is the harness correction
accepted source IDs and allowed-ID enums
limited_inferences: Terminal tool stage only when recorded worker error explicitly names it; other runtime failures remain unattributed.
Last invalid call without a terminal worker error may be a running correction, not a failed stage.
metric_scope.timing_note: Summed call/case seconds overlap under concurrency; they are not job duration. Cached-history lock waits may be in case time.
